data.body:
Kickoff — executing epic 3405-c0b7-0436-4b46 "Audit all error codes for descriptiveness" per the authoritative implementation brief (latest epic comment). 5 leaf bug children + 1 epic-level prevention guardrail, landed as a Gerrit relation-chain stack bottom→top: f75f (error_code_for narrowing, core) → fbc0 (_structured_llm_failure uses error_code_for) → 7d47 (observable render_workflow test, rides f75f) → 0aee (register pinned_ticket_read_failed in KNOWN_ERROR_CODES) → 5f96 (split coverage.llm_unavailable, add input_rejected, update 3 readers) → guardrail (exhaustive exception→code contract test + vocabulary-closure test).

Unified principle: reserve llm_unavailable for isinstance(exc, LLMUnavailableError) only (incl. LLMConfigError); every other LLMError → command_failed. Discriminate by exception TYPE.

Environment: fresh worktree /Users/joeoakhart/errorcode-taxonomy on branch errorcode-taxonomy from origin/main (5ae9eb72b86b release 0.13.1). venv provisioned, commit-msg hook active. Landing method: Gerrit (git push gerrit HEAD:refs/for/main), rebar-ticket trailer + DCO, close each child only after Verified+1 AND LLM-Review+1. No --force anywhere; gates run unbounded.

Gate config confirmed: require_plan_review_for_claim=true (bugs exempt), require_completion_verification_for_close=true, require_plan_review_for_close=true. Epic is not bug-exempt, so I will review-plan the epic before claiming it.

Source recon complete: LLMError hierarchy — LLMUnavailableError(+LLMConfigError) are the only genuine outages; LLMRunnerError subclasses (LLMInputRejectedError, RunawayToolLoopError, LLMBudgetExhaustedError, ContextWindowExceededError, StructuredOutputError/UnretryableOutputError/CompletionRecoveryError) and WorkflowError family are non-outages. error_code_for branch 6 (src/rebar/_errors.py:127-130), _structured_llm_failure (src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py:22), gate degrade producers (_degraded_code_review_verdict gate_dispatch.py:336, _degraded_plan_review_verdict plan_review_recovery.py:462), readers (drift_floor.py:202, orchestrator.py:468, review_bot/adapter.py:114), pinned_ticket_read_failed emit (_reads.py:99), render_workflow tool (_mcp_reads.py:557) via _mcp_errors error guard → error_code_for.
